landing.faq_q1: Is Nammooru Bus free to use?
landing.faq_a1: Yes, 100% free with no ads, tracking subscriptions or hidden fees.
landing.faq_q2: Do I need an account to check bus timings?
landing.faq_a2: No, anyone can search buses, check routes and view live maps as a guest without signing up.
landing.faq_q3: How accurate is the live location?
landing.faq_a3: Live locations update every few seconds directly from the on-duty driver phone GPS.
landing.faq_q4: Does it work with slow or offline connections?
landing.faq_a4: Yes, route timetables, stop lists and cached maps work even with spotty connectivity.
landing.faq_a5: Currently live for the Hubballi-Dharwad twin cities urban network.
landing.faq_q6: How do drivers join the platform?
landing.faq_a6: Drivers register with an authorised transit secret key to broadcast their active bus trip.
